text:
jia: Quick heads-up — Priya just got promoted to Senior Eng AND baby Arlo arrived this morning 🎉👶! Want to do a tiny office celebration tomorrow at 4? Options: flowers + card, meal train, or both?
omar: omg congrats Priya!! ❤️ I'll grab a card.
elise: woah double win!! flowers + card for sure. I can order flowers if someone shares the nursery colors.
sam: meal train sounds great. happy to coordinate sign-ups. @marco can you handle the card?
marco: yep can do card. what’s the best spot to keep it? front desk?
rachael: front desk works. or leave with People Ops (I can pick it up) — also post the registry link pls
noah: flowers by me. what day/time for the dropoff?
jia: thanks! dropoff by 3pm tomorrow would be great. @priya — do you want us to keep this quiet until you post something? (no pressure)
priya: omg you guys 😭 thank you!! feel free to share — Arlo is 3.2 lbs and doing fine. card at front desk sounds perfect. registry: https://babyregistry.example/priya-arlo
omar: sending sweets too? local bakery does tiny empanadas and pastelitos — vote :+1: for empanadas
elise: :raised_hands: empanadas
sam: :thumbsup: baker or cake? empanadas ftw
marco: added a tidy Google sheet for meal sign-ups: https://tiny.one/priya-meal-train
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: 'Priya & Baby Celebrate' — Tomorrow 4:00 PM — Kitchen
jia: perfect. I'll order flowers (neutral palette). Thanks everyone! also +1 for empanadas
ops-bot: Note: For food deliveries to office please label 'People Ops' and drop at kitchen table. Catering delivery window 3:00–3:30 PM.
priya: can't wait to see you all, thank you for being so thoughtful 💜
omar: bringing a tiny stuffed turtle. because Arlo's favorite animal is obviously a turtle
sam: love that. who wants to sign the card today? i'm passing by the front desk at 10:30
elise: me, 11am
rachael: I'll add a short message from People Ops on the card
gina: quick ask — anyone have a neutral vase we can borrow for the flowers? i can drop it back Friday
noah: I've got one in my desk. leave it with janitor or ops.
omar: tagging @facilities too — FYI for pickup/dropoff
facilities-bot: Facilities notified. We'll leave keys with front desk.
jia: ok, closing loop: flowers ordered, meal-train link shared, card @front desk, celebration tomorrow 4pm. Thank you team! :tada:
